notes.title: Essential RPG Sea of Stars is cheaper than ever to celebrate new, free story DLC

Much as Clair Obscure Expedition 33 has forged a new path for what JRPGs can be in 2025, so Sea of Stars did two years prior. The stunning pixel-art adventure from Canadian team Sabotage Studio shares a lot of common ground with Sandfall Interactive's masterpiece. It draws tremendous inspiration from genre classics, with Chrono Trigger in particular a clear influence, then builds on those concepts with fresh ideas of its own, garnishes them with satisfying combat, and wraps them in beautiful art direction. Now, as Sabotage unleashes a major story DLC for free, you can get Sea of Stars at its lowest price yet on Steam.

notes.title: Sea of Stars: Throes of the Watchmaker Free DLC is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[b]The time has come: Throes of the Watchmaker — the free DLC for Sea of Stars — is out now![/b]

We spent nearly two incredible years crafting this free DLC as a heartfelt thank-you to our fans. Your support made it possible, and we hope this bonus final adventure for Sea of Stars will bring you joy.

To celebrate the launch, Sea of Stars is currently available at its lowest price since release, with a limited-time discount of 35% off!

[previewyoutube=tgFi2jXwzVI;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to help in bringing more eyeballs to this circus-themed romp, the best way is always to leave a comment on the trailer on YouTube, and share [our posts] on social media.

[h2]How To Access The DLC?[/h2]

1.  The DLC is not included as an automatic update. To get started, you’ll need to manually download it from Steam or your console’s storefront.

2. Throes of the Watchmaker is a post-game adventure, so you must open up a save file where you have rolled the end credits at least once to unlock access.

3. After meeting the requirement above, return to the world map in-game. You’ll receive a new prompt via a message-in-a-bottle: It’s a message from Hortence urging you to return to the Vespertine and check on Keenathan.

When prompted with: [i]“Hortence sounds really worried. Should we visit the crew right now?”[/i] Choose [b]Yes[/b] to continue.

4. You’ll be transported to the top deck of the Vespertine. Head below deck and speak with the pirate crew to officially begin the Throes of the Watchmaker side-adventure.

5. [b]Malevolent spectacle awaits![/b]

[h2]Italian Localization[/h2]

Great news for our Italian friends! 

Italian localization is now available for both the Sea of Stars main adventure and the free DLC.

[h2]Alright, Time to Play Now![/h2]

This release marks the full realization of everything we set out to build — first with Dawn of Equinox, and now with this DLC. What a journey it’s been over the last few years! We’re incredibly grateful for your support at every step of the way. 

We hope that this farewell letter to our dream project will bring you joy, and that you will allow it to tell you one last time, from all of us: THANK YOU!

All the love,
-SaboTeam

notes.title: New Sea of Stars DLC is a completely original eight-hour campaign, totally free
notes.notes:
On the surface, Sea of Stars is an appeal to basic nostalgia, a kind of aesthetical victory lap for the likes of Chrono Trigger and Earthbound. But the longer you play it, the more it becomes a credible, modern RPG in its own right. Already one of the genre's most beloved, while Monster Hunter Wilds, Clair Obscur Expedition 33, and of course Oblivion Remastered occupy the charts, the new Sea of Stars DLC makes Sabotage's 2023 hit feel fresh again. Dawn of the Equinox added couch co-op and a rebuilt combat system. Now, Throes of the Watchmaker is bringing an entirely new, post-main-game campaign. And not only is it totally free - we now know the release date.

notes.title: Very good RPG Sea of Stars gets a free eight hour DLC campaign about a creepy clockwork circus
notes.notes:
"A beautifully made retro-inspired RPG that will instantly transport you back to the 16-bit golden years, for better or worse," was how Katherine Castle (RPS in peace) summarised Sea Of Stars, a Chrono Trigger-style pixelart sojourn down memory lane from Sabotage Studios, creators of The Messenger. I imagine it's better rather than worse for the addition of some sizeable, circus-themed free DLC, Throes Of The Watchmaker.

Out 20th May, the expansion adds a new playable character, Arty, together with an estimated eight hours of new areas, music, dungeons, minigames, enemies, bosses, puzzles, and playable classes for original protagonists Valere and Zale. Run your rose-tinted retinas over this trailer.

notes.title: Throes of the Watchmaker is Coming May 20th + New Trailer!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The day is set: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457510/Sea_of_Stars_Throes_of_the_Watchmaker/]Throes of the Watchmaker[/url] — the free DLC for Sea of Stars — is coming to all platforms on May 20th, 2025!

The announcement was made this morning, accompanied by a whole new trailer showcasing the scope, narrative, and tone of this wacky post-game bonus adventure. We hope you're as excited as we are, because the playtest results are in and it clocks over 8 hours of completely new content!

The scope of this DLC went way beyond what we initially envisioned, which was only made possible through the warm and overwhelming response we have been blessed with.

[previewyoutube=tgFi2jXwzVI;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to help  in bringing more eyeballs to this circus-themed romp, the best way is always to leave a comment on the video on YouTube, and share our posts on social media.

[h2]THROES OF THE WATCHMAKER DEV STREAM, TODAY AT 2PM ET![/h2]

The trailer is here, and the release date is set — it’s time to celebrate! Join us live later today as we showcase Throes of the Watchmaker. We’ll take you inside the miniature clockwork world of Horloge to explore the DLC’s unique mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/0040b6dc6206026984c0f70992e584bb38b45cc4.png[/img]

Come on and join us at 2PM ET, it should be a lot of fun: twitch.tv/sabotagestudio


[h2]MALEVOLENT SPECTACLE AWAITS[/h2]

Since it’s been a long time since our latest update on the DLC, here’s a recap of what you can expect from Throes of the Watchmaker.

[h3]Over 8 hours of completely new Areas, Music, Dungeons, Mini-Games, Enemies, Bosses, and Puzzles[/h3]

Journey into a magical miniature clockwork world where a plethora of oddities and wonders await. The world of Horloge is filled with unique environments, NPCs, enemies and dungeons. This thing is packed, with Throes of the Watchmaker boasting the same budget for cinematics that the main game had, allowing us to richly realize key narrative moments and deliver this new tale with even more density and production value.

And of course, Sabotage’s composer Eric W. Brown returns alongside guest composer Yasunori Mitsuda to bring a completely fresh set of tracks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/af9d786f53751119d84ddd6fc1262c8cbae03352.png[/img]

[h3]New Playable Classes for Valere and Zale[/h3]

The world of Horloge plays by different rules, and for their magic to manifest, the Solstice Warriors will need to adapt. Zale will tap into his agility to become a Juggler, while Valere will harness her balance to dazzle as an Acrobat. Playing to the circus-themed curse, they will unlock a completely new set of attacks, damage types, skills and combos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/ae04cc1afe3aa5a9b08a8607981e3b15ce6cbdcc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/a70d882fc064c81ff370c31659a60320c2b2ab76.png[/img]

[h3]New Playable Character: Arty[/h3]

Artificer joins the party! The friendly engineer robot will finally unlock the laser-shooting capabilities of his construct, and join Valere and Zale in the fight to save Horloge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/eea80f22ab179a0d2d84b5705393c0152f573db9.png[/img]

[h3]Couch Co-Op With Up To 3 Players[/h3]

The couch co-op mode that was added to Sea of Stars via the Dawn of Equinox update in November 2024 is also available for Throes of the Watchmaker. It allows up to three players to engage in traversal and combat with a “Co-Op timed hits” mechanic!

[h2]THAT’S IT FOR NOW[/h2]

We’d love for you to join us for the Throes of the Watchmaker DLC dev stream later today! If you can’t make it, no worries — the VOD will be available tomorrow, and we’ll see you on May 20th when the DLC launches for free, everywhere.

We hope that this farewell letter to our dream project will bring you joy, and that you will allow it to tell you one last time, from all of us: THANK YOU!

All the love,
-SaboTeam

notes.title: The Dawn of Equinox Update is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[b]The Dawn of Equinox update is available to download for free on all platforms, right now![/b]

Here’s the new trailer, showcasing some of the main changes coming with the update:

[previewyoutube=pk6FYIift0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We ultimately see Dawn of Equinox as the community’s gift to us - the overwhelming support you’ve all shown us ever since we first announced Sea of Stars helped give our team the chance to return to the project, and present a refined version of it including everything we ever hoped this adventure to be.

There's even more in store in the upcoming DLC Throes of the Watchmaker, but in the meantime, we couldn’t be happier with how Sea of Stars feels with this major update.

[h2]DAWN OF EQUINOX UPDATE OVERVIEW[/h2]

In case you missed it, the key changes were presented comprehensively during [url=https://youtu.be/mDDSCbmXmBk]a livestream[/url] a few weeks ago.

[h3]3 Player Couch Co-op[/h3]

Sea of Stars’ adventure is now playable in its entirety by up to three players, with allies traversing the world together and mastering a new Co-op Timed Hits combat mechanic. Yes, what was initially presented as a more limited “Single Player +” mode has evolved into a full-fledged co-op experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/4a320147836eac1c83a1c22f85b5ef7ac1cd8485.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/f0f63a72d8c74a6d5fcc6272e1366477523d2a43.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/7a836d6af59acc2d08d7c5edab06a93063a4e8d7.png[/img]

[h3]Combat 2.0[/h3]

The addition of Mystery Locks brings a new gameplay loop around revealing the ways to break the spells of new enemies entering the fray. Along with "Reveal" functions added to some of the special skills, Combo Points now remain after battle, offering new ways to open certain encounters, or test different damage types on enemies to reveal their locks. 

A comprehensive balancing pass has also been done to reflect both these new changes and player feedback since launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/6234c5decad3c300d7105e087b2267bc8fc504b6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/127a0baaa284716c11bbe25c34605cb884bec91a.png[/img]

[h3]A revamped prologue[/h3]

Implementing combat for the young versions of our heroes, the updated flow does away with the flashback structure to begin in their childhood directly including action in the prologue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/c8caf743e97cb06e7b3efded71d75581bbac1b2d.png[/img]

[h3]Bonus Cinematic Scene[/h3]

An entirely new cutscene has been added to accentuate a pivotal moment in the original adventure, referred to as "Paths on Water".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/c91cbd8a2e266dfcc0fddce488188f073196d18e.png[/img]

[h3]Speedrunner Mode Relic[/h3]

This new Relic was designed with the help of the speedrunning community, activating a range of features helpful for those looking to set a new personal best or world record.

[h3]Difficulty Presets[/h3]

Three difficulty settings are now available when starting a new game, which are presets using the game's Relics. New Relics have also been added, some for quality of life, and others for difficulty adjustments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/a3336be64774dcce23dd2601de363027ac172b06.png[/img]

[h3]Improved Parrot Relic[/h3]

The secret-tracking parrot has learned a few new tricks to better assist players tracking down overlooked challenges and collectibles.

[h3]Québécois Localization[/h3]

The long-awaited, comprehensive French Canadian translation for our Québec folks is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/6b2f88a138eccb32dc7a3164d5c934ffeb139a70.png[/img]

A number of other general updates, bug fixes and QoL improvements spanning Sea of Stars’ full campaign are also part of the Dawn of Equinox update.

[h2]THAT’S IT FOR NOW[/h2]

We’re grateful for all the love and support the game has received over the past year, which made it possible for us to fully realize our vision. We hope this will give fans of the game plenty of reasons to revisit it while waiting for the upcoming DLC Throes of the Watchmaker, coming Spring 2025.

All the love,

-SaboTeam

Enter Sabotage Studio's Sea of Stars, another indie-developed RPG inspired by Crono, Marle, and Lucca's time-hopping quest, along with other classics such as Super Mario RPG. notes.title: 2022 Wrap-Up + Road To Launch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It’s been a while since our latest big announcement for Sea of Stars and it feels like an update is long overdue. For the past months we have been fully dialed in on concrete milestones to take this dream production home, and we're happy to report that both the team and the game are doing great!

While everyone's patience and support has been felt by all of us, we want you to rest assured that getting closer to launch also means slowly reemerging from the depths of gamedev to communicate more, starting of course with our community.

So, here’s a wrap-up of the highlights of 2022!

[h1]SEA OF STARS IS ON TRACK TO RELEASE IN 2023[/h1]

While there is still a lot of work left, the path to launch is clearer than ever. The whole team is aligned and on pace to complete the production for Sea of Stars to release in 2023.

Working towards the infamous BETA milestone, technical unknowns are now behind us and all gameplay systems are locked-in. We are hard at work completing content, balancing and fine tuning the game's moment-to-moment experience.
 
While we cannot provide a specific release date yet, we want to reaffirm that 2023 will be the year Sea of Stars is released.

[h1]FROM TITLE SCREEN TO END CREDITS[/h1]

Four years ago, a small team began work on the level design tools and renderer code that would be required to deliver the vision for Sea of Stars: unshackled traversal, dynamic lighting, and seamless turn-based combat.

As of writing this,  the game's main path is fully playable from title screen to end credits. Game mechanics sing the way we were hoping they would, and the story has been finalized with all levels fully playable.

In case you don’t follow us on social media, here’s a few updates you might have missed.

First, a look at the cooking menu.

[previewyoutube=b64OraUoNT4;full][/previewyoutube]

Here’s a quick stroll through Zenith Academy, with Valere and Zale as kids.

[previewyoutube=PKH-X-57O_w;full][/previewyoutube]

Oh, and here's a big boss just for fun!

[previewyoutube=FQBVGhHfkbQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]SO, WHAT'S LEFT?[/h1]

A bit of optional content, a lot of NPCs, localization, a whole lot of bug fixing, and an impossible amount of polishing. We are currently operating on a weekly build-review schedule, covering every segment of the game with the finest brush, ensuring readability of the levels, balanced combat, and properly paced cutscenes. 

To reach BETA, we need every and all moments and  elements of the game to be at the highest  quality we can produce.

[h1]THE LAST STRETCH[/h1]

Once the game reaches BETA (content complete), we will work towards the last milestone, GOLD (bug-free), making sure Sea of Stars offers the best experience for everyone, on all its supported platforms. This implies performance optimization, accessibility, compliance, localization and quality assurance.

As a reminder, the game will be available in  English, French, German, Russian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, simplified Chinese and traditional Chinese.

[h1]LOOKING STRAIGHT AHEAD[/h1]

As 2023 approaches, it is clear that we have a big year ahead of us. For now, it is time for the team to take some well-deserved time off, recharge and spend time with loved ones before we all get back together to finish this journey at last.

Again, your support, patience and optimism means a lot to the team. It carries us in these efforts, and after all this time has never failed to mean the world to us. We can’t wait for the moment you all finally play Sea of Stars!

Until then, thank you once again for everything, and we wish everyone a happy 2023!

With love,

[b]-SaboTeam [/b]

For over a year we have been working with PlayStation dev kits to make sure it ran as smoothly as on our other target platforms. To avoid spoilers, we showcased the same content as the Nintendo Switch trailer, but still made a point to recapture everything on PS4 and PS5 directly!

Emphasizing our two main priorities (quality of the finished game, and a healthy work-life balance for the team), production remains a road where the unexpected occurs a lot even if the destination is set. Where there is a wall we tear it down, where there is a tree we walk around it, and where there is a gem we pick it up. The vision remains clear, but seeing the response and hype we made the conscious decision to make sure to leave no gems on the floor. Something special is happening here, and we are committed to making the most of it.

A precise release date will be announced as soon as we pass the Beta milestone.

[b]Once again, thank you all for your overwhelming positivity and patience. [/b]

[h1]NEXT STEPS[/h1]

With virtually all technical risks  already tackled, the team is focused on finalizing the game's content. 

In closing, we want to once again thank you for your patience. It’s a long ride, and your overwhelming support goes a long way in keeping the team's motivation high. We feel truly blessed, and can’t wait for you to experience Sea of Stars in its final form.

With love,

notes.title: New Trailer!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam community,

We’ve been quiet here since the start of the project, but we plan on being more active going forward, starting with a pretty significant first update. 

[b]We’re thrilled to finally reveal a new trailer!
[/b]
[previewyoutube=b8BiyYO6loU;full][/previewyoutube]

It premiered during Indie World as we officially announced that Sea of Stars is coming to Nintendo Switch. If you’re interested in adding Sea of Stars to your Switch wishlist, the page is now up on the eShop.

We’ve already updated our Steam store page with the new trailer, new screenshots, and a few new visual assets, check it out!

(If you want to help bring more eyeballs to Sea of Stars, [url=https://twitter.com/seaofstarsgame/status/1471164519133196294]please RT this post[/url]!) 

[h2]THE TRAILER IS MEANT TO BE SPOILER FREE
[/h2]
As always, deciding where to draw the line in how much to show  is a challenge we take very seriously. If it was up to us, nothing would be shown to preserve the entirety of the experience. In reality, there has to be some give for people to be aware of the game, especially given the self-publishing indie studio need to build a community.

If you are mindful of spoilers, rest assured that only a small portion of the game was shown at this point, and that each shot was hand-picked to convey a mandatory portion of the promise without giving too much away.

[h2]HOLIDAY 2022 IS THE TARGET, BUT WE WON’T RUSH THE GAME.
[/h2]
To clear all the potential confusion that could arise from different interpretations of the Winter 2022 / Holiday 2022 messaging, let us say plainly that the target is to launch Sea of Stars roughly a year from now.

The exact date will be announced sometime next year once we have a clear view of when the game will be as good as we can make it. As always, the only thing we will not compromise on is quality.

[h2]2021 IS A WRAP
[/h2]
2021 was a big year of production for us, and we are happy to report that Sea of Stars is emerging as something that exceeds our expectations, mostly due to the overwhelmingly positive response and additional talent joining the team.

For 2022, production remains the top priority, but we will also be talking about the game a lot more as we get closer to release, with many more announcements and promotional activities already planned.
But for now, it is time for the team to rest. We want to thank you for the unbelievable support, and wish you all happy holidays. See you next year! 

Got questions for us? Drop us a line here, or feel free to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/sabotagestudio]Discord[/url]!

-SaboTeam
